guard: an alias resolves to its extension within its kind, a name or alias already claimed by a name or alias is refused at registration, live, staged and at commit, unregistering frees the aliases, and a command's own declarations refuse an alias equal to its name and two subcommands sharing a word
why: Which extension a word resolves to must never depend on load order, so the registry refuses a second claim on a word whatever the claim is. Each mutation drops one leg of that rule and must redden the assertion that names it.

mutations.name: an alias is not claimed at registration
mutations.expectRed: an alias equal to a live name registered
mutations.cell: an alias equal to a live name registered

mutations.name: a stage's own claims do not block a later staged registration
mutations.find: for (const staged of stage?.values() ?? []) for (const key of claims(staged)) taken.add(key);
mutations.expectRed: a staged alias did not block a name staged after it
mutations.cell: a staged alias did not block a name staged after it

mutations.name: a commit does not re-check what went live after staging
mutations.find: for (const ext of staged) for (const key of claims(ext)) if (taken.has(key)) throw new Error(`extension already registered: ${key}`);
mutations.expectRed: a commit published an alias claimed after staging
mutations.cell: a commit published an alias claimed after staging

mutations.name: unregistering keeps the aliases
mutations.expectRed: an unregistered command's alias was still claimed
mutations.cell: an unregistered command's alias was still claimed

mutations.name: resolution ignores aliases
mutations.expectRed: has() did not see an alias
mutations.cell: has() did not see an alias

mutations.name: an alias equal to the command's name is accepted
mutations.find: if ((cmd.aliases ?? []).includes(cmd.name)) problems.push(`command "${cmd.name}" lists its own name as an alias`);
mutations.expectRed: an alias equal to its command's name was accepted
mutations.cell: an alias equal to its command's name was accepted

mutations.name: two subcommands may share a word
mutations.find:
if (holder !== undefined) problems.push(`command "${cmd.name}": "${word}" names both subcommand ${holder} and ${sub.name}`);
      else seen.set(word, sub.name);
mutations.expectRed: two subcommands sharing a word were accepted
mutations.cell: two subcommands sharing a word were accepted

mutations.name: a command resolves by prefix
mutations.replace: return commands.find((cmd) => cmd.name === word || (cmd.aliases ?? []).includes(word)) ?? commands.find((cmd) => cmd.name.startsWith(word));
